_metadata.description: Catalog and run history plus health/observability surfaces for backup state.

requirements.title: Catalog and run history
requirements.description: List targets, destinations, plans, and runs; show last-success per target; browse the contents of a snapshot.

validation.notes: After runs, assert listings and last-success-per-target; assert snapshot browse returns entries.

requirements.title: Health endpoint flags overdue/failed backups
requirements.description: The health endpoint reports degraded when any target is overdue or its last run failed. Backup outcomes are emitted as events for platform monitoring (infra-health/system-monitor).

validation.notes: Seed an overdue/failed target; assert health degraded and an event is emitted.
